dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: *sigh* What should I do...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Nothing's wrong... except I might need to start looking for a new job soon.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: The other day, the innkeeper asked me to prepare a new dish that would attract more guests.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: It should be presentable and tasty, but also stylish and artisan. Oh, and have personality...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I've been trying to come up with something satisfactory over the last week, but the innkeeper didn't like any dish I came up with.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did you make?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I gave it all I had, really. I utilized everything I learned while honing my culinary skills in the mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Candied Silk Flower, Qingxin and Lotus Seed Duck Stew, Crab Roe Stewed Meatballs...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: ...But he would shake his head at everything and ask me to give it another thought.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: But I've already reached my limit, eh...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah, right! I still gotta cook something for that freeloader. It's about time he came around...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you mean Jiangxue?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Unless you know of any other parasites who'd shamelessly come here every day asking for food...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Since you're already here, why don't you grab a bite too? You can sit over there. I'll serve the food when it's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What do you think you're doing? You can't just waltz into the kitchen whenever you feel like it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Wh—Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I am Yanxiao, a sous-chef.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Unless you have something seriously urgent to tell me, you'd better get out of my kitchen.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Just a sous-chef?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What's the big deal? Didn't you see me chopping meat and making a soup?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: You're not the first person to show surprise at me working as a chef, though.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: My story goes like this: I actually used to be a thief until I stole from the boss.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I took a beating for it and was locked up for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: After I got out, the boss took me on to help out in the kitchen.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I find I'm much happier as a sous-chef than I was as a thief.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I feel like this is the real me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bye-bye.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: See you later. Wait no — don't come back in here!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Huh? What are you doing just sauntering on into the kitchen?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: It's fine. Kindness should be repaid in kind and however it goes.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I'm hardly about to kick you out, not after you helped me with that ghost problem and all.

choices.text: Tell me a bit about your life to date.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: What're you asking that for? Aren't you here to cook?

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: I feel like this is the real me.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Pretty good. Ever since then, I've stopped seeing anything weird.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: But even if something pops up again, I'll be fine. The boss met an exorcist called Chongyun through some friends.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: If another ghost pops up, we'll call him in. Besides, they say he's pretty good at his job.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bye-bye.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Go well, eat well.
